purpose: Explicit database transaction ownership and failure cleanup, without implicit success commits or new business semantics.

inventory_scope.discovery: Python AST; direct calls per containing qualified function, excluding nested function/class bodies from parent counts; grouped method and receiver counts.
inventory_scope.test_helpers: Included under TEST_ONLY; not production transaction owners.
inventory_scope.scope_limit: Declared database receiver syntax is statically checked; aliases such as current and self._session are covered by the named owner/participant groups and runtime integration tests. This scanner is not a complete dataflow analysis.

ownership_groups.description: Admitted POS and Backoffice financial and physical commands share one durable idempotency transaction owner.
atomic_effects: canonical financial and physical effects, including frozen quantities, conversion, weighted-average cost and FEFO allocations
explicit branch order policy versions, frozen commercial revisions and lifecycle events
separate post-economic-commit print requests and hardware intentions; no physical success assertion
allowed_savepoints: known inventory lot identity creation race
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Unexpected failure rolls back root and key; deterministic rejection rolls back the action and retains its declared terminal result.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Lost response is recovered by the same identity; no automatic action repetition or external effect inside the transaction. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.
ownership_groups.verification: PHYSICAL_BLOCK_ACCEPTANCE_IN_PROGRESS; prior financial evidence retained separately

ownership_groups.description: Authorized immutable result lookup without action or new reservation.
atomic_effects: existing safe authentication activity, if supplied by HTTP
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Failure rolls back the lookup transaction without changing the stored result.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Response transport only. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Bounded expired-payload purge retaining immutable identity.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: The public owner rolls back all payload changes; its private helper never owns root cleanup.
ownership_groups.post_commit: No worker schedule is implied. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Standalone administrative application methods retain explicit commit sites.
atomic_effects: existing required audit and outbox; see functional matrix per case
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: rollback_on_failure discards unfinished effects; only named 23505 business constraints are translated.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Existing read projections may execute after commit; a later response failure does not undo durable changes. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Session commands own successful transitions and deliberate security-rejection evidence.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Unexpected failure rolls back unfinished work. Deliberate counters/block/revocation commits before rejection remain durable.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Cookie/HTTP response follows the explicit commit. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Session endpoints own commits around participating activity and revocation helpers.
atomic_effects: session activity or revocation and required trace
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: rollback_on_error cleans unfinished endpoint work; no helper autocommit.
ownership_groups.post_commit: HTTP response only. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Privilege helpers and session helpers compose within an explicitly declared owner.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: No helper root commit or rollback; caller decides the outcome.
ownership_groups.post_commit: None independently. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: FastAPI session dependency closes request transactions without implicit commits.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Rollback any unfinished read or write transaction on exit, then close the session.
ownership_groups.post_commit: None. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Shared failure-only cleanup utility; never a success owner.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Rollback and re-raise BaseException; no commit, retry or business translation.
ownership_groups.post_commit: None. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Denied business request rollback followed by a separate audit transaction.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Rejected business effects are rolled back first; a separate Session context owns denial audit cleanup.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Original denial returned; this is not a successful business command. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Explicit bootstrap/recovery CLI database owner with protected recovery material.
atomic_effects: privilege state, account, grants and required trace
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Unfinished database changes roll back; existing protected-file compensation/recovery rules apply independently.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Private recovery-material publication is not distributed ACID with PostgreSQL. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Explicit development seed command; no operational runtime ownership.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Session context discards unfinished seed changes.
ownership_groups.post_commit: No production provisioning claim. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Operations CLI owns the credential-change connection transaction.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Connection context rolls back uncommitted changes; private material keeps its documented recovery boundary.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Private credential-file replacement retains its existing failure rules. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Current independent outbox poller owns a read transaction.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Engine.begin rolls back an exception and releases locks; no durable claim or processing state is written.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Metadata logging after transaction exit; no handler, delivery or processed acknowledgement. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.description: Guarded source helpers used only by isolated tests.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Caller/session context cleans failed fixture setup; never used as runtime authority.
ownership_groups.post_commit: Test data only. Failure cleanup never reverses an already committed transaction.

ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Commit the durable claim before the provider call, release database locks, then reconcile authoritative evidence in a separate guarded transaction. Any incomplete local transaction rolls back; uncertain provider outcomes retain the same identity.
ownership_groups.post_commit: No provider call is retried as a new charge after UNKNOWN; read the same provider operation. Evidence and local terminal state are durable before acknowledgement.

ownership_groups.description: Bounded independent local database probe; no economic command or Internet dependency.
ownership_groups.failure_behavior: Session context closes and rolls back its unfinished SELECT transaction; bounded pool/connect/statement timeouts prevent waiting indefinitely on command capacity. SQLAlchemy failures become sanitized UNAVAILABLE.
ownership_groups.post_commit: No commit, business mutation, retry queue or external network call. Writable-primary readiness is an observation, not a guarantee of the next command outcome.
ownership_groups.verification: FIVE_FOCUSED_LOCAL_CASES_PASSED; physical deployment and full block acceptance remain separate

read_only_boundaries.rule: No automatic commit; unfinished reads and writes roll back on request exit.
Explicit transaction completion for authorized lookup; no command action or reservation.
Read-only Engine.begin transaction; row locks end before logging and no durable processing state exists.
Only PostgreSQL recovery/read-only settings are observed. Session closure discards the read transaction; the bounded probe pool is separate from command capacity.
Read-only commercial quote. Creating or revising a commitment revalidates its fingerprint inside the command transaction.
Recover the exact authorized policy-version acknowledgement by original intention; never create another version.
Reauthorize the existing stored device command against current actor, branch, workstation and registered binding. Does not create a new intention or confirm physical output.
Read and integrity-check the stored immutable receipt; do not fabricate historical snapshots.

The seven-file regression passed all 134 cases. AST calls and commit locations are unchanged. Local manifests identify edited source, not immutable-commit acceptance; verified Foundation SHA and workflow link accompany delivery.

delegated_entries.rule: Select one explicit owner; the delegator does not commit or roll back. A subsequent detail-read failure cannot undo the selected owner commit.

operation_context_extension.rule: Immutable context snapshots and transaction-local GUC propagation do not change commit ownership. Savepoint rollback restores its parent context, root end clears Session context, and independent denial audit explicitly preserves safe request provenance.
operation_context_extension.verification: Four ownership gates passed; 25 unique producer cases passed across 24 initial and three final cases with overlap. Final context/authentication cleanup regression passed 10/10; storage/audit passed 13 unique cases. Full local results and diagnostic runs are recorded in operation-context-validation.md.
operation_context_extension.preserved_039_record: The existing verification object and retained_boundaries record the historical 039 acceptance. The 040 correlation and maintenance-identifier follow-up is implemented and verified separately by this extension; later boundaries remain open.

pos_feature_complete_extension.ownership_rule: IdempotencyExecutor remains the only root owner of adopted order, receipt-print and hardware-intention commands. New helper flushes participate in that transaction; audit, outbox and acknowledgement are atomic with their local facts. A hardware call happens after economic confirmation and cannot roll it back.
pos_feature_complete_extension.migration_rule: Alembic owns schema migrations outside the runtime scanner roots. New immutable receipt, order-policy/revision and hardware-intention data are not fabricated for history. Downgrade guards and migration acceptance require their own isolated evidence.
pos_feature_complete_extension.readiness_rule: Local readiness is an independent read-only observer, never a financial owner or a browser offline queue. Failure after an admitted POST remains uncertain until the original intention is recovered.
pos_feature_complete_extension.physical_boundary: A persisted print request, signed command or browser print dialog does not establish printed paper, an opened drawer or successful external payment. Device/provider certification and operational acceptance remain external evidence.
pos_feature_complete_extension.verification: IMPLEMENTED_LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE_IN_PROGRESS; referenced test files identify coverage and do not by themselves prove successful full-block execution.
pos_feature_complete_extension.preserved_acceptance: The top-level ZM-FIN-039 verification and ZM-FIN-040 extension retain their historical scope and evidence. They are not claims of validation for migrations 0054-0056 or the new POS block.
